title: Correct-by-Construction IDEs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Correct-by-Construction IDEs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Correct-by-Construction IDEs — iDEs where wrong programs won't compile.

Phase 1 — Prove (refinement editors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (IDE logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (specification panes): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (tactic support): IDE hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
